limitations: Archived field raw_retained uses same frozen disease equations/fit and TPV but field forcing-days policy; exact full-season climate wrapper has terminal-completion validity and detection-gated integrated accounting.
Fullgrid and attribution values are normalized affected-tissue proxies with unvalidated physiological canopy meaning.
Common-overlap and whole-window integration are different estimands, both valid conditional questions; sign reversal does not disprove all biological buffering.
No verified source-native mapping except BASF code0 flag leaf; all-leaf and source-top3 results retain anatomical qualifications.
BASF F1 subset scores are reaggregated from reused saved predictions and include no new independent outcome test.
Full protocol, cultivar mapping, natural senescence and disease-specific yield relationship remain unqualified.
Monitoring17-level score cannot validate autonomous projection model.
